hero.desktop: display: flex; gap: var(--spacing-md); padding-top: 8px; padding-right: 8px; padding-bottom: var(--spacing-md); padding-left: 8px; position: relative; background-color: var(--colors-brand);
hero.tablet: display: none; align-items: stretch; justify-content: space-between; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-template-rows: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); row-gap: 12px; flex: none; height: 640px; min-width: 100px; max-width: 1000px; min-height: 10px; max-height: 900px; overflow: clip; background-color: transparent; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, #000000 0%, var(--colors-brand) 100%); border-width: 0px; border-top-width: 1px; border-bottom-width: 1px; border-style: dashed; border-color: #11223344; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 8px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 2.5px; box-shadow: 0px 4px 12px -2px var(--colors-brand); opacity: 0.9; mix-blend-mode: color-dodge; filter: blur(2px);

icon.desktop: position: absolute; top: -4px; right: 0px; bottom: 0px; left: 10px; z-index: 2; width: 24px; aspect-ratio: 1;
icon.tablet: grid-column: span 2 / span 2; grid-row: span 1 / span 1;

id2.desktop: display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; height: fit-content;

map.desktop: background-image: url(/assets/photo.png); background-size: auto; background-repeat: repeat;

title.desktop: font-family: var(--tf-font-inter, "Inter"); font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-align: center; text-decoration-line: line-through; text-transform: uppercase; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: #111111;
